The marching tetrahedra algorithm is inspired by the marching cubes algorithm. The objective of this marching cubes algorithm is to reconstruct the surface of some sort of shape or object. By defining a grid of cubes or tetrahedra, one can create triangles in each one that maintain connectivity, forming a 3d mesh.
